lines: І Чигирь Жабина, єдиного свого юнаце
notes: Card is oriented upside-down in image. Text appears to be from a panegyric source. Some words difficult to read with certainty: 'муриваючи' possibly 'пророчь муриваючи' (prophecy-related?), 'мдариі' possibly a name or epithet, 'нємєш алино' unclear. The source reference 'Треgem' may need verification - possibly 'Трегем' or similar.
